maddeler.e:
أستجهل (form X)
# أَسْتَجْهِلُ (ʔastajhilu) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.hi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# أُسْتَجْهَلُ (ʔustajhalu) /ʔus.tad͡ʒ.ha.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# أَسْتَجْهِلَ (ʔastajhila) /ʔas.tad͡ʒ.hi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# أُسْتَجْ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
